m: परि-√ या P. -याति, to go or travel about, go round or through (acc.), RV. &c. &c.; to run through i.e. assume successively (all shapes), RV. ix, 111, 1; to surround, protect, guard, RV.; to avoid, shun, ib.; to flow off (as Soma), ib. : Caus. -यापयति (ind.p. -याप्य), to cause to go round or circumambulate, MBh.
परि-याणीय mfn., Kāś. on Pāṇ. viii, 4, 29.
परि-याण n. going about &c., Kāś. on Pāṇ. viii, 4, 29 (cf. पर्याण).
परि-याणिक n. a travelling carriage, Gal.
परि-यात mfn. come near, arrived from (abl.), R.
one who has travelled about, Hcat.

k.v: हिमवान्निषधो विन्ध्यो माल्यवान्पारियात्रिकः। गन्धमादनमन्ये च हेमकूटादयो नगाः॥

m: परि-√ यज् P. -यजति (aor. 2. sg. पर्य्-अयास्), to obtain or procure by sacrificing, RV. ix, 82, 5; to sacrifice or worship before or after another, to perform a secondary or accompanying rite, Br.; ŚrS.

v: pu॰ parita umayatI vihitI yajYo'sya । uBayato vihitayajYe vfhaspatisavAdO kAtyA॰ 1 4 । 19 । saMgra॰
m: परि-यज्ञ m. a secondary or accompanying rite (which precedes or follows another in any ritual), KātyŚr.
परि-यज्ञ mfn. constituting a secondary rite, ib.
परि-√ यम् P. -यच्छति, to aim, hit, RV. : Caus. -यमयति, to serve, assist, Sāy.
परि-√ यत् Ā. -यतते, to surround, beset, TāṇḍBr.
परि-यत्त mfn. surrounded, beset, hemmed in RV.; TS.; AitBr.
परि-यष्टृ m. a younger brother performing a Soma sacrifice antecedently to the elder, Āpast. (v.l.)

v: pu॰ pari + yuja--BAve GaY vA dIrGaH । paritoyoge
m: परि-योग m. (√ युज्) = पलि-य्˚, Pāṇ. viii, 2, 22, Vārtt. 1.
परि-योग्य m. pl. N. of a school, L.
परि-√ 2. यु Desid. -युयूषति, to strive to span or embrace, RV. vi, 62, 1.
परि-युत mfn. clasping, embracing, Nir. ii, 8.
